selection_rule: Strongest self-history + stimulus baseline (`is_self_only=True`) by equal-weight mean `E_d` across unexposed main immobilized Dev splits (`seyedolmohadesin2025` 32w + `toyoshima2024` 11 physical worms), per `MODEL_REQUIREMENTS.md` §4-§5.

B1_persistence.description: Zero-change causal pre-stimulus anchor [-2, 0)s (fallback [-10, 0)s / mu_train) held over [0, 10)s.

B2_neuron_stim_mean.family_name: Neuron x Stimulus Empirical Mean Trajectory
B2_neuron_stim_mean.description: Causal pre-stimulus anchor plus empirical-Bayes shrunk training-fold Neuron x Stimulus basis trajectory.

B3_self_arfir_spline.family_name: Regularized AR-FIR / Orthonormal Temporal Basis Self-History
B3_self_arfir_spline.description: Multi-lag [-10, 0)s self-history + derivatives + [-30, -10)s calibration mean-reversion + stimulus schedule ONLY.

B4_ridge_self_stim.family_name: Regularized Tabular Ridge & Repaired Causal MLP
B4_ridge_self_stim.description: Sample-scaled Ridge on causal self-history, functional tier, stimulus schedule, and fold-internal prior drive.

B4_ridge_cross_neuron.family_name: Regularized Tabular Ridge & Repaired Causal MLP
B4_ridge_cross_neuron.description: Sample-scaled Ridge adding target-self- and bilateral-excluded causal circuit state features.

B4_mlp_repaired_self_stim.family_name: Regularized Tabular Ridge & Repaired Causal MLP
B4_mlp_repaired_self_stim.description: Repaired fold-consistent 2-layer residual MLP (self+stim only) using inner-fold priors for early stopping.

B4_mlp_repaired_cross_neuron.family_name: Regularized Tabular Ridge & Repaired Causal MLP
B4_mlp_repaired_cross_neuron.description: Repaired fold-consistent 2-layer residual MLP adding excluded-self/bilateral cross-neuron circuit state.

B5_pop_rrr.family_name: Graph-Free Low-Rank Dynamical Baselines (RRR, LDS+u, GRU, TCN)
B5_pop_rrr.description: Graph-free Reduced-Rank Regression (rank=6) over self-history + excluded-self SVD population subspace.

B5_lds_stim.family_name: Graph-Free Low-Rank Dynamical Baselines (RRR, LDS+u, GRU, TCN)
B5_lds_stim.description: Stimulus-driven Linear Dynamical System (LDS+u, latent_dim=8, 0.5s steps) rolled out from target-excluded z_0.

B5_causal_gru.family_name: Graph-Free Low-Rank Dynamical Baselines (RRR, LDS+u, GRU, TCN)
B5_causal_gru.description: Compact causal GRU (hidden_dim=24) filtering [-10, 0)s binned trace + obs mask + excluded-self context.

B5_causal_tcn.family_name: Graph-Free Low-Rank Dynamical Baselines (RRR, LDS+u, GRU, TCN)
B5_causal_tcn.description: Compact strictly causal dilated 1D TCN (channels=24, k=3, dilations=1,2) over [-10, 0)s + excluded-self context.

B6_poco_univariate_ms_mlp.description: Univariate multi-scale MLP baseline control from POCO (Duan et al. NeurIPS 2025) without population FiLM.

B6_poco_film.description: Causal unseen-animal adaptation of POCO (Duan et al. 2025) modulating self-history via excluded-population FiLM.

B6_ray_gordus_state_gain.description: Causal leaky-ODE state-gain baseline (Ray & Gordus 2025) gating multi-tau stimulus drive by AVA/RIM & dAVA/dt.

B6_capacity_matched_graphfree_control.description: Capacity-matched dense multi-lag low-rank graph-free population control against connectome priors.
